name: brotherds
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Turns a figure that is about to reach a decision into a checkable claim carrying its query, its grain, its uncertainty and what it does not establish, then runs refusals against it and returns PASS, FAIL or NO-DATA. Its own north star, the verified claim rate, currently reports NO-DATA: no claim has yet been scored against a real outcome, so nothing here is proven end to end.
